1 rpm = 2π/60 ≈ 0.10472 rad/s, and conversely 1 rad/s ≈ 9.5493 rpm. For a quick mental estimate, multiply the rad/s value by 10 and subtract 5% to get roughly rpm; here 157.080×9.5493 ≈ 1500.
